name: Scan Docker Image for Vulnerabilities (compliance rendition)
description: Perform a Trivy-based security scan on a specified Docker image to identify high and critical vulnerabilities. Reported for regulatory traceability.

reporting.expectedOutput: Obligations this run evidenced, obligations it did not, the method and thresholds applied, and every stated limit on scope

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_image_scan_technical.json with the same target, parameters and criteria. The compliance profile carries all 25 findings (findingsOmitted = 0) and documents criterion resolution: iso27001 resolves to assessed (evidence bearing on 2 of 6 recorded requirements); dora resolves to assessed (1 of 4); linddun resolves to declaredNotAssessed, since no requirement under it is evaluable by an image scanner; internal_baseimage_policy:v4 resolves to unrecognised. regulatoryCoverage.complete is therefore false, with byStatus {assessed: 2, declaredNotAssessed: 1, unrecognised: 1}. Note that 'assessed' means evidence bears on the listed requirements, not that the regulation is met. The scope limitation is recorded: Trivy always runs with severity filter HIGH,CRITICAL only; lower severities are never collected.
